title: WordPress Designer Needed for High-Converting Book Landing Page
description:
We are looking for an experienced WordPress designer/developer to create a professional, conversion-focused landing page for our published book, Blade Within.

The page will be used as the primary landing page for traffic coming from our Google Ads and other marketing channels. The goal is to present the book professionally, communicate its value clearly, and encourage qualified visitors to click through to purchase the book on Amazon.

Our existing website and brand are already established. We are looking for someone who can work within the current Blade Within visual identity while creating a page that feels polished, modern, credible, and intentionally designed for conversions.

The page should include:
Strong above-the-fold hero section
Book cover/product imagery
Clear headline and value proposition
Prominent Amazon purchase CTA
Key benefits / what readers will learn
“Who this book is for” section
Overview of the book and its core themes
Selected book topics or chapter concepts
Author section
Additional purchase CTA sections throughout the page
Clean mobile-responsive design
Professional desktop and mobile layouts
Strong visual hierarchy
Fast-loading and user-friendly structure
Tracking-ready buttons/links for Google Ads and analytics

The overall design should feel clean, intelligent, serious, modern, and premium rather than like a typical exaggerated self-help sales page.

The Blade Within brand focuses on topics such as:
Judgment
Self-mastery
Discipline
Decision-making
Self-control
Boundaries
Clear thinking
Personal growth

Some of our current marketing language includes ideas such as:
“Better outcomes start with better decisions.”

“Sharpen your judgment with Blade Within.”

“Think clearly. Act with discipline.”

We are open to recommendations regarding layout, hierarchy, UX, and conversion strategy from someone experienced in landing-page design.

Technical requirements
The page must be built directly within our existing WordPress website and should work with the site's current theme/building tools whenever reasonably possible.

The selected freelancer will receive the necessary WordPress access after the contract begins.

Please do not redesign the entire website. This project is specifically for creating one dedicated book marketing/landing page that fits naturally within the existing Blade Within brand.

Ideal freelancer:

We are particularly interested in someone with experience in:
WordPress
Landing page design
Conversion rate optimization
Sales/marketing pages
Responsive web design
UX/UI
Google Ads landing pages
Publishing, books, or e-commerce landing pages

Experience creating landing pages for books, authors, educational products, or personal-development brands is a plus.

When applying, please include:
2–4 examples of landing pages you personally designed
Any examples specifically created for books, products, or paid advertising

A brief explanation of how you would approach this page

Your estimated turnaround time

Whether you handle both design and WordPress implementation

We are looking for someone who can both understand the marketing purpose of the page and execute it professionally in WordPress.

title: WordPress to Shopify Migration + Store Build (Small E-Commerce Launch)
description:
I'm relaunching my travel business as a self-service e-commerce store and need an experienced Shopify developer to migrate my existing WordPress site to Shopify and build out the new store.

The business: Sips & Sights Travel is pivoting from custom travel-planning services to selling two product types directly: digital itinerary guides (PDF downloads) and physical travel gear (a curated wine/whiskey travel kit). No consultations or custom quotes — everything needs to be a standard, self-serve purchase flow.

Scope:

Migrate the existing WordPress site (sipsandsightstravel.com) to Shopify, keeping the current domain
Migrate existing blog content and set up proper 301 redirects from old WordPress URLs to new Shopify URLs (including the blog's /blogs/news/ URL structure change) — preserving what SEO value the site currently has is important
Build out new site structure: Home, Shop (with Itineraries and Travel Gear collections), individual product pages, About, Blog, FAQ, Contact
Set up a digital downloads app for instant PDF delivery on itinerary purchases
Standard e-commerce setup: cart, checkout, shipping rates for physical products, tax configuration
Set up a reviews app and email capture/newsletter integration
Mobile-responsive theme (most of our traffic comes from Instagram, so mobile matters a lot)

I have a detailed written brief covering site structure, page-by-page requirements, brand positioning, and messaging direction — this will be shared with the freelancer I hire, and I'm looking for someone who will actually read it and ask good follow-up questions, not just quote off this listing.

What I'm looking for:

Direct, hands-on experience with WordPress-to-Shopify migrations — not just building new Shopify stores from scratch. Please describe a similar migration you've done, specifically how you handled blog URL redirects.
Comfortable with Shopify Liquid, HTML/CSS/JS, and the Shopify app ecosystem
Able to share live stores you've built/migrated that I can actually click through and test
Clear, proactive communicator — I'd rather get questions upfront than surprises later
coverLetter:
Hi! I can absolutely handle your migration from WordPress to Shopify for Sips & Sights Travel, ensuring you don't lose your SEO value. 

Since I work extensively in both WordPress and Shopify (Liquid), I know exactly how to bridge this gap. To preserve your SEO, I will export your blog content and map out precise 301 redirects from your old WordPress URLs to Shopify’s nested `/blogs/news/` structure using bulk import tools like Matrixify. I've executed similar migrations where maintaining search rankings was critical. I’ll also set up your digital downloads app for the itineraries, configure the physical shipping rates, and ensure the entire checkout is highly optimized for your Instagram mobile traffic.

I'd love to review your detailed brief. Could you share the document so we can discuss the exact page layouts and app integrations?

title: Web Designer for Custom Website
description:
Upwork Job Post: WordPress/Elementor – Multilingual Landmark Info Website (MVP)


Project Description:
We're building a multilingual WordPress website for associations/institutions that gives tourists free information about landmarks via QR code (text + audio) or directly through the landing page of that association/institution. Visitors scan a QR code on-site, land on a subpage for a specific section of the landmark (e.g. Picture next to the main entry of the building), select their language via flag icons, read/listen to the explanation, and can optionally leave a rating/comment which is not visible for other website viewer.
There should be one single subpage per association/institution with a predefined template for each and every interesting element (like picture next to the main entry). 


Current status: 
hosting is live, WordPress is installed, HTTPS is set up, and the following plugins are already installed and activated: Elementor Pro, Polylang, Site Reviews, Pretty Links, UpdraftPlus, Code Snippets. All 7 languages are already set up in Polylang (DE, EN, TR, AL, MK, BS, MS). A first attempt at the header (flag language switcher) exists but is not finished/live yet.


Important: 
I have no web design experience. After this project, I only want to add content myself (text, photos, audio files) via Elementor — the structure/templates need to be fully finished and functional.


One Landing Page:
- Placeholder for some content
- Switch the language with Polylang
- Whenever one new sight-seeing is published it should be visible as a preview in the landing page (last 3 new sightseeings).
- Possibity to search: First country (just the one where minimum one sight seeing already exists (e.g. Germany). Then just the cities where we have already minium sight seeing (e.g. Hamburg), then all names of the sightseeing to open the subpage of that sightseeing.
These three information are visible in the linktree of the website: e.g. www.abc.com/germany/hamburg/harbour


Scope of Work

1. Header (global, via Elementor Theme Builder)
Flag-based language switcher (Polylang), top left or right, working for all 7 languages (more langues might follow later)
Below/next to it, a breadcrumb line: Country / City / Institute
Clean, simple design (not a generic demo layout)

2. Page template for one "Section" (as a reusable Elementor template)
Each subpage (= one sightseeing) needs:
Subpage header (e.g. "harbour")

Title: Entry to main building
Photo carousel (1–3 images with captions)
Audio player (for an uploaded MP3 file)
Text block for reading along
Star rating + comment field including optional image upload (plugin: Site Reviews) – comments/images should NOT be published publicly, only sent to a contact email address (configurable per landmark)
The template must be easy to duplicate, so I can swap out text/image/audio per language/section without rebuilding the layout

3. Link/QR preparation to jump directly to that part of the subpage.
Set up 10 Pretty Links pointing to the (placeholder-content) subpages, plus a short explanation of how I can create additional links myself

4. Handover
A short video guide (English) explaining how I, as a beginner, can:
create a new section page from the template
add text per language
swap out photos/audio
create a new Pretty Link


Technical Environment:
Hosting: All-Inkl
WordPress + Elementor Pro (Theme: Hello Elementor)
Multilingual: Polylang (already configured with 7 languages)
Ratings/comments: Site Reviews plugin (not published - just in backend)
Links: Pretty Links
Access credentials (wp-admin) will be provided after hiring


Not Needed:
No translation work (I'll handle this myself)
No audio recording (I'll handle this myself)
No automation/custom development beyond what's needed (this is an MVP)


MVP
MVP with one example you can decide to show me the results.


Timeline
Completion within 2 weeks preferred.


Application

Please briefly address the following in your proposal:

Experience with the Elementor Pro Theme Builder
Experience with Polylang (multilingual setup)
Experience with Site Reviews or similar rating/comment plugins with image upload
Estimated time and fixed-price quote
coverLetter:
Hi! Your QR-code landmark MVP is a brilliant concept, and I can build this exact setup using Elementor Pro and Polylang within your 2-week timeline for a fixed price of $650.

I specialize in the Elementor Pro Theme Builder and multilingual configurations. I will set up your Polylang flag switcher in the header, build the reusable "Section" template (integrating the audio player, image carousel, and breadcrumbs), and configure Site Reviews to route ratings privately to your admin email instead of displaying them publicly. I have built similar highly structured, easy-to-manage sites, such as https://www.seeintl.org/.

Once the structure is ready, I’ll record a step-by-step video guide showing you how to easily duplicate the template, swap content, and generate new Pretty Links.

Are you free for a quick chat to discuss the private email routing for the reviews?
